text:
rebecca: heads-up — ACME on ticket #123456 reporting sudden console access loss. User can log in via SSO but gets 403 when switching to the 'payments' project. They say this started immediately after an IdP config push.

matt: can you paste the exact user/org + quick repro steps?

rebecca: user joe@acme.com, org: acme-prod (org_id: org_9x8). Repro: SSO -> choose ACME org -> click project dropdown -> select 'payments' -> 403 page from console. If we add them to the project manually they can access it.

sam: dropping the 403 body the frontend shows:
```
{"error":"permission_denied","message":"403: access denied to project payments","request_id":"rq_abc123"}
```

john: did you try a SCIM resync or user repro from our side? any SCIM traces?

rebecca: triggered full SCIM sync at 14:02 UTC. SCIM job completed but member counts look lower than expected. excerpt from SCIM user payload (redacted):
```
{"email":"joe@acme.com","groups":"eng-team,platform,infra,third-party-integrations,very-long-group-list-truncated..."}
```
The groups list appears truncated on their side.

matt: that smells like an IdP claim length limit. Okta/AD sometimes truncate SAML/OIDC claims or have 1024 char limits on attributes. If the customer's group list is huge the 'roles' or 'groups' claim can be clipped.

sam: eng-identity, can we check authz service logs for request_id rq_abc123 and the SCIM ingestion record?

opsbot: authz trace: https://logs.internal/redwood/trace/rq_abc123 (internal link, access controlled). SCIM job id: scim_20260315_1402.

john: looked at the authz trace. The incoming OIDC token contains a 'roles' claim that ends mid-string (ellipsis) — downstream SCIM processed the shorter list and the user lost project-specific role bindings. Effectively they were removed from the 'payments' group.

matt: short-term workarounds: 1) add joe@acme.com to project 'payments' as a direct member or make them org-owner temporarily; 2) ask customer to enable group-filtering / smaller role-claim on their IdP; 3) use SCIM patch to restore groups.

rebecca: told customer the direct-add workaround, they accepted org-owner temp. They want a permanent fix.

sam: I'll file INF-4231 against eng-identity to investigate making SCIM mapping resilient to truncated claims and to add stronger validation/logging when a claim length exceeds N chars. Assigning to @john.

john: thanks — I'll pull the SCIM payload, the trace, and contact the customer's IdP admin for exact claim limits. Also proposing an alert when SCIM sync reduces group count by >20% for an org.

rebecca: perfect. I'll close the loop with ACME once we have a remediation plan. Thanks all :thumbsup:

matt: quick note for runbook: include this as an entry under "SSO claim truncation" with steps to manually add project access and to request group filtering from the IdP.

rebecca: will do. following up with customer in ~30m.
